# OpenCC browser converter

Pinned npm package `opencc-js@1.3.1`, `dist/esm/t2cn.js`, served locally for simplified-Chinese poetry display. Source: https://github.com/nk2028/opencc-js . npm tarball integrity verified against registry `dist.integrity` when vendored. See LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.

The original uploaded text and annotation anchors remain canonical source text; conversion is for display only. No external network request sends reading text.
